description: Itineraires Velo PDESI CD76 decembre 2023 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de la Seine Maritime. Cycling routes registered or in the process of being registered in the Departmental Plan of Spaces, Sites and Routes (PDESI) relating to Nature Sports (see glossary in metadata) of the Seine-Maritime in December 2023. Coverage: Département de la Seine Maritime. The portal shows the English title as "Itineraries Velo PDESI CD76 December 2023" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département de la Seine Maritime. Its keywords include tourisme-durable, itinerance, randonnees, sport-et-loisirs, geospatial, pdesi. The listing shows 6 download or service links in GEOJSON, KML, WEB PAGE, ZIP. The listing shows 2024-03-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
